info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Open Banking Event Notification-v5-spec
info.description: The Open Banking Event Notification API allows businesses to seamlessly integrate and receive notifications about significant banking events. This API serves financial institutions and developers, enabling them to subscribe to real-time updates related to account activities, transactions, and other pertinent banking events. Typical use cases include enhancing customer engagement, ensuring regulatory compliance, and automating workflows based on banking events. The API streamlines communication between banking systems and third-party applications, fostering an ecosystem of innovation in financial services.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create a new event notification in the system. The notification can be configured based on specific criteria and will be triggered when those criteria are met.
